To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the communication of sustainability is shifting from communication to persuade others towards communication about sustainability.
the communication of sustainability issues is a crucial part of the solution to sustainability problems.

sustainability communication is a complex and multi-dimensional phenomenon that involves a variety of communication modes and that communication is an important element of transdisciplinarily, deliberative and governance processes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
communication as a means of coping with sustainability issues.
communication about and communication for sustainability, which is a prerequisite for sustainability communication to be successful.
the role of communication for sustainability in society.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sustainability communication has not yet been achieved.
sustainability communication is a complex and dynamic process, and that it has a high potential to foster sustainable development.
sustainability communication is not a “one size fits all” solution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
communication about sustainability is needed to cope with sustainability’s complexity and uncertainty.
the communication of sustainability is a key factor for sustainability transitions.
sustainability communication is a crucial factor for sustainability transitions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sustainability communication is a complex phenomenon and that it is not only about communicating to others but also about communication within and across societal subsystems.
communication modes are crucial in understanding sustainability communication and that communication subsystems are a promising approach to study sustainability communication in practice.
sustainability communication needs to be understood in a broader context, including the societal subsystems it is part of.
